lines.1: Shinichi swiftly slipped a thousand-yen bill into Inori's sleeve.
lines.2: 「Judging by her wristband's signal, Yoppi is in Class 2-C.」
lines.3: 「Perfect! I'll beat the weaklings, wait for the strong ones to wipe each other out, and victory is mine!」
lines.5: 「Will it really go that smoothly, I wonder?」
lines.6: 「I-if I stay in the classroom, nobody will come all the way in here, right?」
lines.9: Yoshimi abruptly clamped her mouth shut.
lines.10: She held her breath and waited for whoever it was to pass.
lines.14: 「(D-did they stop? Who is it?! If it's Ellie or Tsushima...)」
lines.19: 「...Maybe it's time I made a move.」
lines.25: 「Why must two people in love fight each other?」
lines.28: 「Then I'll let you go if you can escape while I count to ten.」
lines.29: 「Stop talking like some kind of villain.」
lines.30: 「Subaru got away from me earlier, and I haven't taken down a single person. I'm feeling rather frustrated.」
lines.35: I hurriedly dodged to the right.
lines.36: 「Good dodge. That only makes tormenting you more worthwhile, though.」
lines.38: She gleefully poured shots into me.
lines.40: I somehow kept dodging with sideways dives like a goalkeeper in a penalty shootout.
lines.41: 「Hmm. Your movements are getting repetitive. I'm bored of that.」
lines.45: Something flashed red high above and far behind the Princess.
lines.49: A rain of shots poured down.
lines.51: Sensing the danger at once, the Princess evaded it with animal agility.
lines.53: The Princess sprang back and crouched as low as possible, ready to return fire.
lines.54: 「The roof? Only Otome would shoot from a place like that.」
lines.56: 「Princess, into the shadows! Let's fall back to the edge of Matsukasa Park!」
lines.57: 「Don't presume to give me orders, Tsushima!」
lines.58: 「Still, we're completely exposed here. I suppose we have no choice.」
lines.60: 「You know, Tsushima, you could have attacked me while I was distracted.」
lines.61: 「I want to win, but not badly enough to take you down for it.」
lines.62: 「Hmm. Then will you be my disposable pawn?」
lines.63: 「'Disposable pawn' sounds so sad. You're a Princess, so that makes me your knight.」
lines.65: Heh. Maybe that was a little too cheesy.
lines.68: She slapped me on the shoulder again and again.
lines.69: 「Ahahahaha! That's wonderful! The straight face is the best part. It's so painfully corny that it's hilarious!」
lines.70: 「I wasn't trying to make you laugh.」
lines.71: 「Hehehe... Forgive me. You're a jester too good to kill. By all means, let us team up.」
lines.72: 「Otome looks like she will be trouble.」
lines.74: 「What? Are you sulking because I made fun of you?」
lines.78: She studied me from close range.
lines.80: 「Ahahaha! You don't have the face of a knight at all! Ahahahahaha!」
lines.82: ...Maybe I really was a patient man.
lines.86: 「W-waaah! Samesuga, you're really scary right now!」
lines.87: 「Oh, man. Chasing a defenseless person might actually be fun.」
lines.88: 「You'd understand this thrill if you tried it! (Please do not.)」
lines.106: 「That was close, Yoppi. That creep nearly got you.」
lines.108: 「Your hands were shaking just now, Yoppi. You'd never hit anything shooting like that.」
lines.109: 「You need to plant yourself, aim, and fire.」
lines.115: 「...I didn't mean for you to practice on me.」
lines.116: 「I-I'm sorry, Date! I didn't mean to...」
lines.118: 「Fukahire is out, just as predicted. Date is a surprise, though.」
